learningModules.title: Module 1: Onboarding Drop-off Anatomy
learningModules.description: Understand the isolated activation failure at step 3 of your onboarding sequence.
learningModules.content: Users who reach the 'Connect Your Analytics' step complete it only 18% of the time. The integration wall requires leaving the app to retrieve API keys — a context-switch that kills momentum.

learningModules.title: Module 2: Progressive Disclosure Fix
learningModules.description: Replace the hard integration gate with a demo-data bypass.
learningModules.content: Add a 'Try with sample data' button that seeds the dashboard with anonymized benchmark data. Let users experience the aha-moment before demanding integration effort.

learningModules.title: Module 3: Activation Telemetry
learningModules.description: Deploy PostHog funnel tracking on your onboarding sequence.
learningModules.content: Track: step_1_complete, step_2_complete, integration_attempted, integration_skipped, demo_data_used, first_insight_viewed. These events reveal your exact activation drop-off points.

learningModules.title: Module 4: Iteration Cadence
learningModules.description: Set up a weekly onboarding review ritual.
learningModules.content: Every Monday: review step completion rates. Every 2 weeks: test one micro-change. Every month: full sequence audit. Activation is not a project — it is a system.

checklist.task: Audit the 'Connect Analytics' step for cognitive cost
checklist.tip: Count the number of context switches required. Each one costs ~37% of user momentum.

checklist.task: Add 'Try with sample data' bypass button
checklist.tip: Label it: 'Explore with Benchmark Data →'. Make it visually prominent, not hidden.

checklist.task: Deploy PostHog funnel events on all 5 onboarding steps
Set up weekly activation dashboard in PostHog
checklist.tip: Build a funnel: Signup → Step 1 → Step 2 → Step 3 → First Insight Viewed.

diagnosis.signal: 61% of signups complete step 1 and 2 of onboarding. Only 18% complete step 3 (analytics integration). Of those who skip step 3, 92% churn within 14 days. The activation bottleneck is clear, localized, and solvable.

friction.rootCause: Step 3 requires users to navigate to a third-party platform, locate API credentials, copy them, return to the app, and paste them correctly — all before experiencing any product value. This is a 6-action context switch in the first 3 minutes of use.

decisions.label: Add demo data bypass at integration step
decisions.action: Add a secondary CTA below the integration form: 'Try with sample data →'. This routes users into a fully functional demo environment seeded with anonymized benchmark data.
decisions.reasoning: Removes the hard gate without eliminating the integration option. Users who experience the aha-moment first will return to connect their real data within 24-48 hours at significantly higher rates.
decisions.tradeoff: Requires building a seeded demo state. Engineering estimate: 2-3 days.

decisions.label: Make integration optional at signup — defer to day 3
decisions.action: Remove the integration gate from the onboarding flow entirely. Let users reach the dashboard immediately. Trigger an integration prompt on day 3 via in-app message after they've experienced 2+ insights.
decisions.reasoning: Value precedes commitment. Users who see real insights first are 4x more likely to complete the integration than those asked to integrate cold.
decisions.tradeoff: The dashboard must function meaningfully with demo data. If the core value requires live data, this approach requires more engineering for the demo layer.

decisions.label: Auto-connect via OAuth and pre-fill with most common setup
decisions.action: Replace the API key form with a one-click OAuth connection for the top 3 analytics platforms (Google Analytics 4, Mixpanel, PostHog). Auto-detect the most common configuration.
decisions.reasoning: Reduces the 6-action context switch to a single click. OAuth is a trusted, familiar pattern that eliminates the cognitive cost of credential management.
decisions.tradeoff: OAuth integration requires engineering work per platform. Prioritize the platform 80% of your users come from first.
